results.title: Cha Ye-ryun reveals diet recipes for actor husband
results.content: Click here for more articles by Kormedi.com. Actress Cha Ye-ryun has revealed the diet meals her husband, actor Joo Sang-wook, actually ate while filming a drama. On Oct. 15, Cha uploaded a video to her YouTube channel titled “Three Simple Diet Recipes by Cha Ye-ryun for Losing Weight Deliciously.” The dishes she prepared were cabbage tortilla pizza, a Greek yogurt bowl and chicken breast salad. “This is a diet you can follow while enjoying delicious food,” Cha said in the video. The chicken breast salad, in particular, drew attention. Instead of using commercially processed chicken breast, Cha opted for fresh chicken breast. “I slice the cabbage in advance and simply grill the chicken breast in olive oil,” she said. “Other chicken breast products are already seasoned, and these days you can get all kinds of flavors.
